title: Petition of New England Power Company for a determination by the Department that certain electric transmisssion lines which will begin in the Town of Saugus at a connection with Petitioner's exisitng Franklin Park-Lynn right-of-way, so called, and extend for a distance of approximately one-quarter mile in a generally northerly direction through portions of said Town to a connnection with a proposed 115 kV substation of Refuse Energy Systems Company, for the porpose of supplying electricity to said New England Power Company, for distribution and sale by the latter, are necessary, will serve the public convenience and be consistent with the public interest, and for said Department to authoritze the petitioner to construct and use said line.
